title: test_build_details.test_platform fails for 32-bit builds on a 64-bit kernel
author: aozmekik
body_preview: # Bug report  ### Bug description:  `test_build_details.test_platform` compares the `platform` key of build-details.json with `sysconfig.get_platform()`. title: http client putrequest changes active continue timeout after rejected call
author: tonghuaroot
body_preview: a putrequest call stores the continue timeout before checking the connection state. a second putrequest call can raise cannot send request and still replace the timeout of the request already being built.  moving the assignment after the successful state check preserves the active request timeout.

title: _interpchannels: `ChannelID.__eq__` reads module state from sys.modules without a check
author: grgalex
body_preview: ### Bug report  ## Summary  `ChannelID` comparison looks the extension module up by name in `sys.modules` and reads its state with `PyModule_GetState`, without checking that the object found is this extension's module.  If the entry is replaced with a plain module, `PyModule_GetState` returns `NULL` without setting an exception, and the comparison returns `NULL`, which the interpreter reports as a...

title: ctypes: array slice assignment replaces the value's `__len__` exception with a ValueError
author: grgalex
body_preview: ### Bug report  ## Summary  Assigning a sequence to a slice of a ctypes array calls `PySequence_Length` on the value. When the value's `__len__` raises, `PySequence_Length` returns `-1` with the exception set, and the code reads the `-1` as a length. The comparison `-1 != slicelen` is always true, so it raises its own `ValueError("Can only assign sequence of same size")` over the pending exception...

title: sqlite3: exception from a collation callback is replaced by SystemError
author: grgalex
body_preview: ### Bug report   ## Summary  When a collation callback raises, sqlite3 returns `0` to SQLite and leaves the exception pending. SQLite keeps evaluating the row, and a later failure in the same step (here `abs()` of the smallest 64-bit integer, an integer overflow) makes sqlite3 build its own `OperationalError` with the collation's exception still set. The interpreter reports this as a `SystemError`...

title: Fix return type of __lazy_import__() (again)
author: JadenV15
body_preview: Sorry all, my earlier [pull](https://github.com/python/typeshed/pull/16742) was incorrect. Confusingly, `__lazy_import__()` is able to return a `ModuleType` OR a `LazyImportType`. See also [this issue](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/161715).
